scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight on a multi-lane urban road when a taxi ahead makes a sudden U-turn from the opposite direction, cutting across the ego's path and stopping in front of the ego vehicle.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane and decelerates to avoid colliding with the taxi that cuts across its path.

adversarials.behavior: The taxi makes a U-turn from the opposite direction, crosses the double yellow lines, and stops directly in front of the ego vehicle in the same lane.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a straight multi-lane urban road with double yellow lines separating opposing traffic, and the adversarial taxi starts in the oncoming lane before crossing into the ego's lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario terminates when the ego vehicle comes to a stop behind the taxi or successfully avoids collision.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road near where the taxi initiates the U-turn.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashboard-camera vehicle; the green-yellow taxi is the sole adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego approaches straight while taxi is visible ahead in oncoming lane. Midpoint, taxi initiates U-turn crossing double yellow lines. Ending, taxi completes U-turn and stops directly in front of ego, which brakes to avoid collision. 3. Evidence: Taxi's position shifts from oncoming lane across double yellows into ego's lane; ego's decreasing distance to taxi and brake lights confirm deceleration.
